title: Talk, Judge, Cooperate: Gossip-Driven Indirect Reciprocity in Self-Interested LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLM agents to coordinate social norms and perform evaluative judgments (praising vs. criticizing) on others' behaviors based on community standards of trustworthiness and cooperation. This constitutes an evaluation of moral judgment and normative reasoning in strategic social environments.
